verses.text: Now, about the collection for God's people: do what I directed the churches in Galatia to do.
On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside an amount in keeping with your income, so no collection has to be taken when I arrive.
When I get there, I'll send the people you approve, with letters, to deliver your generous gift to Jerusalem.
If it's appropriate for me to go too, they'll travel with me.
I'll visit you after I go through Macedonia, since I'm traveling through there.
I may stay with you for a while, perhaps even spend the winter, so you can help me on my way wherever I go.
I don't want to see you just briefly. I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord allows.
I'll stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
because a great opportunity for effective work has opened up for me, and there are many who oppose it.
If Timothy comes, make sure he has nothing to fear while he's with you. He's doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
So don't let anyone look down on him. Help him continue his journey in peace so he can come to me. I'm expecting him along with the brothers.
About our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to visit you with the brothers, but he wasn't willing to go just now. He'll come when he gets the chance.
Stay alert! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
Let everything you do be done in love.
You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and that they've devoted themselves to serving God's people. I urge you, brothers and sisters,
to submit to people like them, and to everyone who works and labors alongside them.
I'm glad Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived. They supplied what was missing from your support,
and they refreshed my spirit and yours. Show appreciation for people like them.
The churches in Asia send greetings. Aquila and Priscilla warmly greet you in the Lord, along with the church that meets in their home.
All the brothers and sisters send their greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand.
If anyone doesn't love the Lord, let them be cursed. Our Lord, come!
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
My love is with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
